## Overview

Often the most important part of a simulation project is the problem definition (what is the purpose of the model?) and the mapping of the system being modelled. System mapping should not be rushed; it is a chance to build a shared understanding with your team and stakeholders.

In this session, you'll learn the types of questions that simulation can help answer, and how to map a process or pathway.

## 🎯 Learning objectives

By the end of this session, you should be able to:

- Understand what simulation is and how it can be applied
- Write a clear problem statement 
- Understand how to map a system and identify the key components and relationships

## 📖 Before the session

Please complete the [pre-learning materials](pre-learning.qmd). These typically take 60 – 90 minutes and are essential for getting the most out of the session.
